user.title: Add a live-snapshot camera
user.description: Pick a camera with a WebRTC live view, such as a Ring camera. You get a button and an image entity for on-demand live frames. The `ring_live_snapshot.capture` action works for any such camera without adding it here.

error.camera_unavailable: That camera is not available right now.
error.no_webrtc: That camera has no WebRTC live view.

abort.already_configured: That camera is already set up.

capture.name: Capture live frame
capture.description: Opens the camera's live view, saves a fresh frame, and closes the stream. Wakes battery cameras for a few seconds.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: Camera with a WebRTC live view.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Optional path to save the JPEG to, e.g. under /media.

settle.name: Settle time
settle.description: Seconds of video to read after the first frame before keeping one.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Give up if no frame arrives within this many seconds.

draw_boxes.name: Draw boxes
draw_boxes.description: Draws labelled boxes on a saved image, e.g. boxes returned by a vision AI task.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Where to save the annotated JPEG.

objects.name: Objects
objects.description: List of {label, box_2d}, where box_2d is [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000 (Gemini's format).

detect.name: Detect objects (Roboflow)
detect.description: Runs a Roboflow object detection model on a saved image and returns the boxes. Needs roboflow_api_key under ring_live_snapshot: in configuration.yaml.

source.name: Source
source.description: Image to run the model on.

model_id.name: Model
model_id.description: Roboflow model ID with version, e.g. package-detection/3.

confidence.name: Confidence
confidence.description: Minimum confidence (0-1) for a detection to be returned.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Optional path to save a copy with the boxes drawn.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Optional list of {label, box_2d} from another detector (e.g. Gemini). The response's confirmed list keeps those a Roboflow box overlaps.

min_iou.name: Minimum overlap
min_iou.description: Intersection over union (0-1) a Roboflow box needs with a box in Confirm to confirm it.
